lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: The prior inspectability gap is resolved: the source card opens a full-screen view and the executable journey double-taps to zoom before returning to editable OCR. A seeded OCR-error correction and source-region-to-edited-text relationship are still not proven.
findings.evidence: source-image-inspection.png and the 33.005-second UI result prove the synthetic original is opened and zoomed before submission; RelationshipCaptureTests prove Vision OCR on a generated image; artifact-manifest.json does not include a seeded wrong-name or wrong-date correction fixture.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter can now materially inspect the source, but a plausible OCR correction is not yet demonstrated end to end or traceable to an image region.
findings.recommendation: Add a low-contrast fixture with one seeded wrong name or date, then preserve enough source-to-edit provenance to show what the reviewer corrected without treating raw OCR as truth.
findings.verification: The source enlarges without losing the draft, the reviewer corrects the seeded error before submission, and the persisted fragment contains reviewed text while retaining the source and review receipt.

findings.observation: Apple's contact editor is the exact authorization gate and cancellation is truthful, but duplicate detection, a successful save receipt, correction, and durable audit or reconciliation are not proven.
findings.evidence: apple-contact-editor-review.png shows only reviewed name and phone in CNContactViewController; contact-cancelled-receipt.png shows no saved contact after Apple's discard confirmation; artifact-manifest.json marks save and duplicate cases not run.
findings.user_impact: A contact can be duplicated or a later user can lack enough product history to reconstruct what was saved.
findings.recommendation: Keep the device-owned boundary explicit, persist a minimal handoff receipt without copying the address book, and test duplicate, saved, cancelled, and permission-change outcomes.
findings.verification: Synthetic device-contact tests yield exactly one contact on save, no contact on cancel or denial, and a receipt whose state matches Contacts readback without ingesting unrelated contacts.

findings.observation: Pending screenshots and drafts now use Complete File Protection and are deleted when advanced, and remote Agent admission rejects non-synthetic evidence; however backup exclusion, derived-store deletion, retention aging, and a private-data Claude provider decision are not verified.
findings.evidence: PendingCaptureInbox.swift writes screenshot, metadata, and draft with completeFileProtection and RelationshipCaptureTests verifies the protection class; agentRuns.ts enforces AGENT_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SYNTHETIC_ONLY; claude-agent-live-runtime.json contains synthetic-only trials.
findings.user_impact: The product cannot truthfully claim that Claude processes private WeChat evidence or that every derived representation is deleted until those lifecycle and provider controls are proven.
findings.recommendation: Keep production private evidence blocked from Claude, define screenshot retention and backup behavior, test deletion across raw image, draft, fragments, Wiki, caches, and receipts, then complete a provider-specific private-data admission review before widening scope.
findings.verification: A deletion inventory test observes no remaining raw or derived capture data after the disclosed boundary, and a separate approved provider-admission gate documents purpose, training, retention, region, access, and incident controls before any private live trial.

strengths: The prior fixed-thumbnail issue is resolved by a full-screen, pinch- and double-tap-zoomable source view exercised in the r7 UI journey.
Speaker attribution begins unresolved, requires an explicit review choice, and candidate Agent proposals remain unavailable until candidate attribution is confirmed.
The raw image stays on device, pending files are protected, and remote Claude execution is synthetic-only.
The Agent manifest contains only read_pursuit, read_evidence, stage_pursuit_proposal, and record_no_action; 30 deterministic and 5 live trials produced zero external effects.
missing_evidence: Seeded OCR correction and source-region-to-reviewed-text provenance.
Successful, denied, duplicate, and reconciled Contacts outcomes.
Backup, retention aging, and deletion proof across every derived capture representation.
Provider-specific approval for private conversation processing; current admission is synthetic-only.
open_questions: Should raw screenshots be excluded from device backup, and what exact retention period should apply to a kept-for-later capture?
